name: clean-code
description: Apply Clean Code principles to maintainability reviews and scoped readability refactors, or when the user asks for Clean Code guidance while implementing or fixing code.

interface.shortDescription: Make code easier to understand, change, and verify
interface.longDescription: Apply Clean Code principles to maintainability reviews and scoped readability refactors, or when the user asks for Clean Code guidance while implementing or fixing code. Uses signal-action-proof guidance for names, functions, comments, errors, boundaries, modules, smells, and tests without imposing arbitrary numeric rules.
